scientific_integrity: Exact affine reduction and invariant-law contraction proof, symbolic exact-rational verification; the main claim is confined to fixed two-component IID stage couplings.

title: Curvature heterogeneity permits an interior-optimal two-stage stochastic-extragradient coupling
